schema.run: run(snapshot, now_ms, ignored) -> findings. Pure: no clock, no storage, no network. Neither the snapshot nor the findings are stored or logged.

snapshot.chats: array of chat entries (any order). One entry per chat this device knows anything encrypted about.
snapshot.chats[].chatId: string, the client's own chat id (Web: user id for 1v1, "-…" for groups).
snapshot.chats[].pairing: "none" | "paired" | "waiting" (own invite sent, unanswered) | "conflict" (another device of this account holds the pairing, 搁置) | "suspended" (sending paused while a replacement key is set up, 挂起) | "mismatch" (safety codes differ, sending blocked) | "mismatch_override" (differ, user chose to keep sending). v2 binding first, then v2 transaction, then v1 pairing.
snapshot.chats[].verified: bool, the current pairing's safety code was confirmed.
snapshot.chats[].inviteReceived: bool, an incoming pairing invite is waiting for an answer.
snapshot.chats[].keyChangedInvite: bool, an unanswered incoming invite from an identity the current binding has never seen (3.43; v1 key_changed).
snapshot.chats[].hasKey: bool, the chat holds a usable send key right now.
snapshot.chats[].groupKeyCreatedMs: int ms | null, group only: when the current group key was made/received; null = unknown.
snapshot.chats[].groupPasswordActive: bool, group only (3.38): the group password policy is on.
snapshot.chats[].groupPasswordUnlocked: bool, group only: unlocked in this run.
snapshot.chats[].keyRequired: bool | null (3.41): null = the chat never had the "refuse to send without a key" switch (never encrypted), else whether it is on.
snapshot.chats[].plaintextOnDisk: bool (3.19/3.44): older history of this encrypted chat is still stored as plain text.
snapshot.chats[].cloned: bool (3.39.13): the chat's key came from a V2Q clone — another device shares this chat's identity.
snapshot.settings.groupKeyMaxAgeDays: int N for check 3, default 90, adjustable on the page; <= 0 means default.
snapshot.settings.wipePhraseSet: bool, a custom wipe phrase is set (3.22; the built-in one always exists).
snapshot.settings.wipeListens: bool, this device acts on a wipe phrase in Saved Messages (3.16 rule 8).
snapshot.settings.netGateEnabled: bool, the 3.37 online gate (Web: always true, it has no switch).
snapshot.backup.lastBackupMs: int ms | null: last full key export/backup this device made; null = never.
snapshot.backup.lastKeyChangeMs: int ms | null: newest key this device received or made (any chat).
snapshot.version.own: string | null, dotted numeric version of this app.
snapshot.version.newestPeerSeen: string | null, newest secuTG version inferred from local data only; null = unknown (no finding).
snapshot.assistant: null everywhere but macOS (no check 11 finding). macOS: { enabled, dataDir, serveConnected, unconfirmedEvents }.
snapshot.account: optional (PLAN.md 3.46.2); missing entirely is the same as every field being null. Read from Telegram when the page opens (account.getPassword has_password, account.getAuthorizations count excluding this device), never from local state, and never written anywhere.
snapshot.account.twoStepPassword: bool | null, check 12: has a two-step verification password set; null = could not be read, no finding.
snapshot.account.otherSessions: int | null, check 13: other devices signed in to this account (this device excluded); null = could not be read, no finding.

schema.ignored: object finding id -> ms when the user pressed Ignore. Hidden while now_ms - at < 30 days (2592000000 ms); at exactly 30 days it is back. ok findings are never hidden. Stored locally only.

finding.id: "c<check>:<chatId or ->:<reason>" — stable, so ignoring survives a re-check; a different reason (e.g. warn->risk) is a different id and re-surfaces.
finding.params: always has "reason"; the rest are the sentence placeholders (days, limit, count, version, peer, dir, serveConnected).

schema.sort: risk, warn, ok; then check ascending; then chatId by UTF-16 code units with "no chat" (empty) first; then id the same way.
rules: 1 (private chats): risk keyChanged (keyChangedInvite) > risk mismatch > warn invite (inviteReceived) > warn suspended > warn conflict > ok paired (paired or mismatch_override). waiting/none: no finding.
2 (private chats): risk mismatchOverride; paired/suspended: ok verified or warn unverified; anything else no finding.

3 (groups with hasKey or groupPasswordActive): days = floor((now - groupKeyCreatedMs)/86400000) when known. risk keyVeryOld days > 2N {days, limit}; warn keyOld days > N {days, limit}; warn passwordLocked (active and not unlocked) {limit}; else ok fresh {limit}.
4 (any chat with keyRequired != null): ok on; warn offWithKey; risk offNoKey.
5 (always one): risk off; warn plaintextHistory {count = chats with plaintextOnDisk}; ok on.
6: warn cloned per cloned chat; no cloned chat: one ok none (action none). No risk level: the state is a fact to remember, not a fault.
7 (only when some chat hasKey): risk never; warn stale (lastBackupMs < lastKeyChangeMs); ok current.
8: ok user; warn env; risk bundled; none: no finding.
9 (always one): risk notListening; risk netGateOff; warn noCustomPhrase; ok ready.

10 (only when both versions known): dotted numeric compare (missing or non-numeric parts = 0). own >= peer ok current; behind with the same major warn behind; lower major risk majorBehind. params {version, peer}, action none.
11 (assistant != null): ok off; warn on; risk unconfirmed (unconfirmedEvents > 0). params {dir, serveConnected, count}.
12 (account.twoStepPassword != null): ok on (true); risk off (false). No warn level.
13 (account.otherSessions != null): ok none (0); warn others (>= 1) {count}. No risk level.
schema.strings: Title SecutgAuditCheck<N>Title; sentence SecutgAuditCheck<N><Risk|Warn|Ok> with params as placeholders; summary SecutgAuditSummary {risk} {warn} {ok}.

notes: Every check 1-13 has at least one ok, warn and risk case except check 6 (no risk level by design), check 12 (no warn level by design) and check 13 (no risk level by design). Levels covered: 10:ok 10:risk 10:warn 11:ok 11:risk 11:warn 12:ok 12:risk 13:ok 13:warn 1:ok 1:risk 1:warn 2:ok 2:risk 2:warn 3:ok 3:risk 3:warn 4:ok 4:risk 4:warn 5:ok 5:risk 5:warn 6:ok 6:warn 7:ok 7:risk 7:warn 8:ok 8:risk 8:warn 9:ok 9:risk 9:warn.
expect is the full, sorted output for that case.

Checks 12/13 (PLAN.md 3.46.2) were added after the other checks; every pre-existing case predates the `account` field, has no `account` key, and keeps the same `expect` (checks 12/13 stay silent) — this is also exactly the 'account field absent' case the port tests require.

cases.name: 1 warn: an incoming invite is waiting
1 warn: another device holds the pairing (搁置)
1 risk: safety codes did not match, sending blocked
1 risk: key-changed invite outranks everything else (3.43)
1 none: own invite waiting, groups and Saved Messages are not paired chats
3 ok: age unknown is not a finding of age
3 ok: exactly N days old is still within the limit
3 warn: N adjusted on the page (30)
3 warn: group password on but locked this run, even with no usable key
3 none: a group without any key
4 risk: was encrypted, no key now, switch off
5 warn: on, but older plaintext history remains
6 warn: one finding per cloned chat (no "none" ok then)
7 warn: backup older than the newest key
7 ok: backup after the newest key
7 ok: backed up, key change time unknown
9 risk: not listening for the phrase
10 ok: same as the newest peer
ignore: a time in the future does not hide (the clock was ahead when it was ignored)
ignore: extreme stored times hide nothing
ignore: a different reason is a different finding, ok findings are never hidden
combined: sorting risk→warn→ok, then check, then chat id (code-unit order), global rows first
12 ok: two-step verification password is set (13 unknown)
12 risk: no two-step verification password (13 ok: only this device signed in)
13 warn: 2 other devices are signed in (12 unknown)
12/13 unknown: account present but both fields could not be read
12/13 absent: the snapshot has no account field at all (pre-3.46.2 shape, old vectors unaffected)
